# Gunshot recordings

Gunshot Sounds by Tabasco, CC0 (public domain).
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/gunshot-sounds
Archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/sounds.zip
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Recorded CZ-52 (pistol), Mosin Nagant (rifle), shotgun, and SKS (assault).
Edits: trimmed single shots, mono conversion, high-pass rumble removal, 24 kHz PCM, peak normalization and tail fade.
Game variants adjust playback rate and level; they do not represent recordings of the fictional weapon models.
Rebuild: python3 scripts/prepare-gun-audio.py /path/to/sounds.zip

# Reload handling recordings

Gun Reload Sound Effects by BMacZero / Brian MacIntosh, CC0.
https://opengameart.org/content/gun-reload-sound-effects
Original files: clipload2.wav, clipload1.wav, singlebullet1.wav.
Stored as reload-out.wav, reload-in.wav, reload-bolt.wav. Playback pitch and timing vary by weapon.
